title: Pack documents and essentials
detail: Originals plus photocopies, passport photos, bedding, a lock, an extension board.
ask: What should I pack for hostel?

title: Open a bank account and set up UPI
detail: So money can reach you without a trip to the bank.
ask: How do banking and UPI work on campus?

title: Plan your route to campus
detail: Decide your train or bus and who picks you up from the city.
ask: How do I reach campus from Vijayawada?

title: Collect your hostel room key
detail: Take admission documents and your ID to the hostel office.

title: Read your hostel's in-time and out-time rules
detail: The notice board in your block has the current timings.
ask: What are the hostel rules and timings?

title: Get your ID card
detail: You need it for entry, library, hostel and exams.
ask: How do I get my ID card?

title: Log in to VTOP
detail: Check your timetable, attendance and fee receipts.
ask: How do I log in to VTOP?

title: Register your devices on campus Wi-Fi
detail: The number of devices is limited, so choose wisely.
ask: How do I connect to the campus Wi-Fi?

title: Choose your mess option
detail: Veg or non-veg, decided at registration.

title: Understand FFCS before registration opens
detail: Shortlist courses, faculty and backup slots.

title: Save the anti-ragging contacts
detail: Know who to call before you ever need to.
ask: Who do I contact about ragging?

title: Find the medical centre and library
detail: Walk there once so you know the way in an emergency.

title: Check your attendance every week
detail: Do not wait for the end of the semester.

title: Join one or two clubs
detail: Recruitment drives happen early in the semester.

title: Learn the CAT and FAT exam pattern
detail: Mark the dates from the academic calendar.
ask: How do CAT and FAT exams work?
